actionsUsed: download and locally inspect loaded production chunks outside the repository

handleRulesObserved: left target and right source are rendered on every visible node
both sides can carry connectablestart and connectableend
instance-level unavailable handles remove connectable/connectionindicator and use pointer-events none
DOM classes alone do not establish business compatibility

bundles.role: canvas connection callbacks and React Flow isValidConnection wiring
LibTV action/type connection matrix and validateGeneratorConnection

GI-004.finding: The normal connection validator rejects an existing edge with the same source/target or reverse source/target, without comparing handles.
GI-004.implication: Same-node-pair parallel edges with different handles are blocked on the normal connection path.

GI-005.finding: The programmatic pair helper explicitly rejects sourceId===targetId; normal non-reference sources also reach the DFS cycle guard.
GI-005.implication: Self-loop is rejected for ordinary connection paths.

GI-006.finding: The normal connection validator builds adjacency and uses recursive DFS to reject a candidate that closes a directed path.
GI-006.implication: A three-node directed cycle is rejected on the ordinary connection path.

GI-007.finding: Both Handle sides may initiate a connection, onConnect normalizes target-start gestures, and action/type/model/capacity validation determines allowed plus optional switchToModel.
GI-007.implication: Handle CSS state, edge direction and domain compatibility are separate layers.
unknowns: all action rows in live UI

adoptMethod: structured validation result instead of boolean-only assumptions
doNotTransplant: global DAG rule over LibTV reference semantics
any source behavior not confirmed by LibTV evidence
